description: A Flutter widget representing the start screen for electronic KYC (Know Your Customer) process, allowing users to initiate EKYC by opening a URL in the browser or a new tab.

classes.name: EKYCStartScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides the UI for the EKYC start process.

classes.name: _EKYCStartScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the EKYC start button, loading state, and URL launch logic.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Initiates the EKYC process by calling the backend API and opening the returned URL in a browser tab or window.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI including start button, status message, and navigation options.
